resources.string: Modern libxposed API 102 and classic LSPatch template with a movable Nyx-styled overlay and optional ShadowHook native scaffold.

LSPosed Universal Template

1. Edit TemplateConfig.TARGET_PACKAGES.
2. Edit META-INF/xposed/scope.list and res/values/arrays.xml.
3. Build: ./gradlew :app:assembleLsposedRelease
4. Install and enable the lsposed artifact in LSPosed / Vector.
 For non-root LSPatch, build assembleLspatchRelease instead.

Current first target: %1$s

The in-app Nyx bubble appears inside the target Activity after Application.attach. Tap it to open the rectangular panel; drag the panel header to move it.
